dispatch.reason: The assessment-bound cloud-disclosure authorization required by BDJ-P01 is not composed on the objective-proposal route, so no dispatch was attempted. Enabling TOKENHARBOR_ENABLED without that authorization would have bypassed a governance control.

authorization.consequence: RegisteredSyntheticBdjDisclosure requires a server-side registry record for the exact run_id carrying owner_id, assessment_id, revision, confirmation_id, source_fingerprint, endpoint, model, rules_sha256, prompt_fingerprint, request_sha256, decision=APPROVED and max_attempts=1. The objective-proposal route performs none of those checks, so a live dispatch from it would disclose entrepreneur source to a cloud model on a source-binding check alone — which the directive forbids.
